styles.name: Casual
styles.instructions: Preserve the speaker's natural voice and wording. Remove fillers and fix punctuation.

styles.name: Gmail
styles.instructions: Format as a clear, polished email with short paragraphs. Preserve any dictated greeting and sign-off. Never invent a recipient, signature, subject, or facts.

styles.name: Prompt engineering
styles.instructions: Organize the dictated request into a clear prompt. Use instructions, context, and constraints only when present. Do not answer the prompt or invent requirements.
